🦖 Welcome to My Dino Life! 

M1 - Bite
R - Special

🍖 Devour food orbs to gain XP and evolve into bigger, deadlier dinosaurs
🌵 Explore 5 unique biomes: Forest, Desert, Snow, Wetlands & Aquatic
⚔️ Battle other players with unique attacks for every species
🦕 Evolve from a Microraptor all the way to the mighty Titanosaurus
🌊 Swim the depths as a Mosasaurus or rule the lands as a TRex

USE CODE: RELEASE

Early Alpha - please expect bugs and limited inventory. Inspired by MorphUp!
